descriptive_previous_comparison.scope: Descriptive cross-source/cross-host comparison only. It does not isolate the cause or quantify a controlled SDK-only speedup.

limitations: No production FPS, absence of frequent GC, universal no-leak or release-readiness result is claimed.
Main page CDP/V8 statistics omit Luau collector events, worker totals and GPU-driver allocations. Heap capacity, pending garbage, decoded RGBA estimates and DOM counts are different scopes.
Two successful intrusive GC RPCs do not guarantee every Blink/native collector completed; unchanged nodes have no established retaining path.
The Game and renderer remain live during post-control reads. Recorded frame/broker changes must be considered before causal attribution; no simulation pause or clock rewrite was introduced.
Tracing, one-Hz CDP/evaluate sampling and post-control GC perturb scheduling. Authorized concurrent project load can affect measured wall time.

Natural report bytes/hash remained sealed after the control. Forced observations are never merged into natural samples or GC frequency data. Browser closure is reported by Root, while recorded remote-handle releases are independently explicit.
